profile.headline: I am retired
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with extensive experience in the development and maintenance of computer and network security products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer experienced in the development and maintenance of computer and network security software for enterprise class firewall products. 
A skilled and tenacious developer and troubleshooter under either application or kernel environments.
Attuned to needs of internal and external customers while delivering robust, high quality software in a timely manner.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the firewall engine software team, developed a diverse set of  features for the McAfee Firewall Enterprise product.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed primarily as a member of the team responsible for the IPsec VPN component of the Sidewinder Firewall.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key contributions to the CyberGuard Firewall development group include:
•	Team lead for the IPsec VPN component of the CyberGuard Classic and TSP Firewalls.
•	Designer and developer of the user authentication component of the CyberGuard Classic Firewall.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishments as a member of the I/O Systems Software Group include:
•	Designed and developed firmware for a VME to SCSI bus adapter supporting two SCSI-2 interfaces
•	Developed device drivers for SCSI adapters and real-time devices

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Diagnostic Software Development Team
•	Designed and developed soft error module for the real-time computer systems deployed at unmanned FAA Terminal Doppler Weather Radar sites
•	Designed and developed the manufacturing acceptance and stress testing software for real-time multi-processor computer systems
